scope: Raw canonical G1 encoder (selector3) + H2 decoder + original MuJoCo WASM physics. No state/reference injection during rollouts; no changes to gains, clipping, targets or timing.

protocol.startup: Production LocalPolicy only; manifest startupHoldSeconds determines frame0/dq0 policy steps. No subclass or method replacement.
protocol.initialization: Unchanged LocalPolicy.reset with controller.initialQpos/default qvel; no motion-specific initial state

limitations: Bounded simulation QA, not a hardware safety guarantee or paper benchmark.
Measurements are at 50Hz policy boundaries. Contact constraints describe the last 1ms physics substep; current kinematics are refreshed without changing solver state.
Flight requires no active floor contacts and both collision-mesh sole minima above the floor. Reference labels or root trajectories alone cannot pass.

Default reset starts slightly above contact; the first .5s cannot count as flight. Standing takeoff is measured from grounded foot advance and double support, not root translation during crouch/push-off.

Kneeling permits shin contact or thigh-mesh contact within 0.15m of the knee joint; no pelvis, torso, head or hand floor contact is allowed. Kneeling torso inclination alone is not treated as falling.
The G1 reference joint angles are not H2 target angles; no cross-robot raw-angle tracking-error score is claimed.
Source foot-body positions are kinematic timing proxies, not source contact/flight measurements. Cross-embodiment distances and raw-angle MSE are not used as tracking metrics.
Status records physical semantic completion; source timing/correlation diagnostics support candidate comparison rather than a paper benchmark.
No browser rendering or scheduling is tested.

sourceBeatDiagnostics.interpretation: Diagnostic only; no change to strict flight/hop acceptance. Contact-free samples and positive clearance peaks can reveal small liftoffs below the 1.5cm/0.06s threshold. Foot-body peak timing differs from sole-clearance timing when the foot rotates. Contact constraints are from the last 1ms substep, so tiny negative sole heights at interval boundaries do not establish continuously positive clearance.

hopSupportQuality.interpretation: Intervening raised-foot contacts are retained as tracking imperfections; qualifying hops only count verified same-foot takeoff/first landing events.

archiveSummary.omission: Only array-valued samples properties were removed recursively. Their lengths are retained as sampleCount. Numeric samples counts and all other metrics, thresholds, provenance, failures, source hashes and sourceChanges are preserved.
